name: SessionHistoryStorage
src_typeComment: Persists to UserSettings/ — the folder Unity itself reserves for per-user, per-project editor state that shouldn't go into source control (already covered by Unity's default .gitignore), which is exactly what a "what was I doing" breadcrumb trail is.

src_members.name: IsNewSession
src_members.comment: Pure — no disk/Editor access — so a self-test can assert the "was I away long enough to count as a new session" decision directly.

src_members.name: IsDuplicateOfLast
src_members.comment: Pure — avoids logging the same object twice in a row (e.g. clicking the same GameObject repeatedly), without suppressing genuinely different consecutive entries.
